title: Низкоуровневый персонаж Томодзаки: Спецвыпуски
alt: Низкоуровневый персонаж Томодзаки: Спецвыпуски Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun Specials Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun Specials
description: Два дополнительных эпизода аниме-сериала «Низкоуровневый персонаж Томодзаки», включённые в третий и четвертый Blu-Ray/DVD издания.

en:
Unaired episodes included in the third and fourth Blu-ray/DVD volumes. 


Entry includes: 


1) Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki: Post-game equipment for girls is a little different than usual


After stopping for lunch at the café where Kikuchi works, the gang chats about love and dating while she tries to listen in--and stay out of sight.



2) Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki: Most strange spell names have unknown origins


Aoi, Mimimi, and Tama reminisce about the early days of their friendship and a fireworks show that provided the inspiration for Tama's nickname.



(Source: Crunchyroll)
